page.overview:
What is Saber Teeth?

Kintaro would be seen with this weapon in the New Timeline while leading his Shokan-Oni army in the Mortal Kombat X Comic Series.

A single bloodied Saber Tooth attached to Kintaro's severed hand is a Krypt Kollector item in MK11, named as the "Shokan Saber Teeth".
